_comment: SPECviewperf gate lanes (docs/design/V3_SPEC_GATE.md). native_s = the CLI wall of one iteration at FullHD on a native Windows 11 LTSC VM, RTX 4090, driver 580.88 (MEASURED, traces/specviewperf_native_20261107/README.md, boxes A and B). tree_gb = decompressed size of the viewset directory (MEASURED, traces/specviewperf_vast_20261105/README.md). budget_s = the longest one viewset may run before it is a FAIL (TIMEOUT): max(1200, 3 x native_s) rounded to 300 s (INFERRED, never measured under kayfabe). setup_s = fetch + verify + copy into the guest + two boots, per lane (INFERRED from the 14 min download, 1.5-5 min hash and 18-21 min copy at 40-45 MB/s). factor = the margin over the native walls that the whole-lane time check demands (INFERRED). tail_reserve_s = kept free at the end for the graceful stop of the guest (win_vm.sh stop allows 420 s) and the verdict. settle_s = the guest runs no viewset sooner than this after its last boot (MEASURED: the first CLI run within about 2 minutes of a reboot failed with 'Unable to gather system details' on two native boxes). Lane order is ascending native_s, so a lane that runs out of time has reported the most rows.
